column1: # Case/Number readings of the Slovene personal and reflexive pronoun forms
# (long, short and bound), written from the pronoun paradigm in
# J. Toporišič, Slovenska slovnica. Bound forms are the accusative after
# za, na, v, pred, med, nad, pod, skozi, čez, ob, po (zame, vanj, predenj).
# Used by the grouper (pronoun form, M-PFORM): the readings a form can
# have instead of the single reading the tagger picks in context.
